We need to extract triplets from this text about Fundamental Rights in India. Identify entities: Fundamental Rights, India, Constitution of India, Part III (Article 12 to 35), Supreme Court of India, Article 32, Indian Penal Code, etc.

We must produce subject_type and object_type. Need to decide appropriate classes: e.g., "Fundamental Rights" is a "legal concept". "India" is "country". "Constitution of India" is "legal document". "Supreme Court of India" is "court". "Indian Penal Code" is "legal code". "Bill of Rights" etc.

Extract facts:

1. Fundamental Rights are basic rights of the people and inalienable rights of the people who enjoys it the charter of rights contained in Part III (Article 12 to 35) of Constitution of India.

So: (Fundamental Rights, part of, Part III (Article 12 to 35) of Constitution of India) maybe relation "contained in". Or "source document". Use relation "source document" or "contained in". Let's use "contained in". object_type: "legal document section". subject_type: "legal concept".

2. Part III (Article 12 to 35) is part of Constitution of India. Could add: (Part III (Article 12 to 35), part of, Constitution of India). But maybe not needed.

3. Fundamental Rights guarantee civil liberties such that all Indians can lead their lives in peace and harmony as citizens of India. So relation "guarantees" maybe "guarantees". Object: "civil liberties". So (Fundamental Rights, guarantees, civil liberties). subject_type legal concept, object_type "concept".

4. Civil liberties allow all Indians to lead lives in peace and harmony as citizens of India. Could capture: (All Indians, can lead lives in peace and harmony, ...). But maybe not.

5. These include individual rights common to most liberal democracies, such as equality before law, freedom of speech and expression, religious and cultural freedom and peaceful assembly, freedom to practice religion, and the right to constitutional remedies for the protection of civil rights by means of writs such as habeas corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari and Quo Warranto.

So we need multiple triplets: (Fundamental Rights, includes, equality before law); (Fundamental Rights, includes, freedom of speech and expression); (Fundamental Rights, includes, religious and cultural freedom); (Fundamental Rights, includes, peaceful assembly); (Fundamental Rights, includes, freedom to practice religion); (Fundamental Rights, includes, right to constitutional remedies); (right to constitutional remedies, exercised by, writs such as habeas corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo Warranto). Could also separate each writ as type of "writ". So (right to constitutional remedies, has instrument, habeas corpus) etc.

6. Violation of these rights result in punishments as prescribed in the Indian Penal Code or other special laws, subject to discretion of the judiciary.

Triplet: (Violation of Fundamental Rights, results in, punishments). But maybe better: (Fundamental Rights, violation leads to, punishments). Use relation "violation leads to". Object: "punishments prescribed in Indian Penal Code". So (Fundamental Rights, violation leads to, punishments). qualifiers: maybe "prescribed in" as qualifier? Could do separate: (Punishments, prescribed in, Indian Penal Code). Also "subject to discretion of the judiciary". So qualifier on the violation leads to: {"relation":"subject to", "object":"discretion of the judiciary"}.

7. The Fundamental Rights are defined as basic human freedoms that every Indian citizen has the right to enjoy for a proper and harmonious development of personality.

Triplet: (Fundamental Rights, defined as, basic human freedoms). Also (Indian citizen, has right to enjoy, Fundamental Rights). Could capture: (Indian citizen, has right to enjoy, Fundamental Rights). relation "has right to enjoy". object_type "legal concept".

8. These rights universally apply to all citizens, irrespective of race, place of birth, religion, caste or gender.

Triplet: (Fundamental Rights, apply to, all citizens). qualifiers maybe "irrespective of" list. Could add qualifiers: {"relation":"irrespective of", "object":"race"} etc. But qualifiers list can have multiple entries. We'll include one qualifier with object "race, place of birth, religion, caste, gender". Might be okay.

9. Though the rights conferred by the constitution other than fundamental rights are equally valid and their enforcement in case of violation shall be secured from the judiciary in a time consuming legal process.

This is about other rights, not fundamental. Might not need.

10. However, in case of fundamental rights violation, Supreme court of India can be approached directly for ultimate justice per Article 32.

Triplet: (Supreme Court of India, can be approached directly, for ultimate justice) maybe relation "has jurisdiction over". Better: (Supreme Court of India, jurisdiction for, fundamental rights violation). Also mention Article 32 as basis. So (Supreme Court of India, jurisdiction for, fundamental rights violation) with qualifier {"relation":"point in time", "object":"per Article 32"}? Actually Article 32 is a provision. Use qualifier "basis" maybe "basis" not defined. Could use qualifier relation "basis" object "Article 32". We'll include.
